# London Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for London. Fireplace installation covers planning and fitting gas, electric, or wood-burning appliances, including the firebox, clearances, connections, and applicable venting.

Email: contact@londonheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://londonheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: London, St. Thomas, Strathroy, Dorchester, Komoka, Aylmer, Lucan. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
